summary: Best version is v3 (Critic score 0.93), which compiles and passes topology. It reconstructs triangle ABC with altitude AD (D is the foot on BC), H on BC, E on AB, F on AC, the dashed G–B–D and F–H strokes, and all eight labels A–H. A visual inspection confirmed a right-angle square at D and no square at F. v4 was an attempt to draw the D square explicitly; it failed the topology check (unverified mark at D), so v3 remains best and v4 should be discarded.
